openings.claim: Counted order trays may reduce switching burden and omissions/substitutions; use length/profile outlines, one layer per position, verified layout/color specifications.
openings.discriminator: Selection/checking and escapes improve; insertion retries may persist.
openings.probe: Counterbalance workers, layouts, mixed/grouped sequences and current/tray methods; time preparation through packing by stage; audit contents, blind-check seeded nondelivery errors, cost upkeep.
openings.uncertainty: Complexity confounds switching; similar parts defeat outlines; preparation may erase savings.

openings.claim: Order-specific diagrams may clarify short-partition position/orientation.
openings.discriminator: Better placement/fewer questions versus correct identification with mechanical retries.
openings.probe: Balance layouts across existing/revised diagrams; record placement, retries, unaided completion/time.
openings.uncertainty: Small screen only; overlapping widths cannot explain retry differences.

openings.claim: Partial assembly with a removable seated short partition may anchor orientation and save insertion labor.
openings.discriminator: Fewer placement errors versus obstructive reseating.
openings.fit: Uncertain: anchor compatibility across layouts and loose-part retention.
openings.probe: Compare current/anchored presentations by layout; record completion, anchor removal, contents, packing time; test retention/cost.
openings.uncertainty: Customer variation; zero damage claims do not establish retention.

decision: Screen sequentially within 15 samples/ten participants; repetitions remain diagnostic. Preserve 30x20 cm, assortment, removability, accepted counts/colors, deadline; costs <=500 initial/0.40 recurring. Require 60-order pilot: >=98% complete, median total workshop time <=8 minutes, >=90% unaided arrangement. Success unestablished.
